decision: The D15 qualification target is the coherent official pairing dsh-v0.1.5-rc.1 / Python deepseek-harness-sdk==0.1.5rc1 / bundled npm 0.1.5-rc.1.
rationale: No Python deepseek-harness-sdk/runtime-bin==0.1.5rc2 is published; an exact npm 0.1.5-rc.2 candidate would have to splice a non-bundled npm closure onto the shipped Python runtime.
runtime-bin==0.1.5rc1 bundles npm 0.1.5-rc.1, so rc.1 is the only coherent, officially paired runtime.
All D15 native-continuity surfaces (Session V3 migration, SessionHandle persistence, cross-process write lease, continuable subagent, persistent terminal) are present in the bundled rc.1 closure.
The upstream rc.2 GitHub release changes only feedback-dialog confirmation and delivered-file card layout, which are outside the BYQ-dependent runtime interfaces.
rc2_disposition: 0.1.5-rc.2 remains recorded as not-a-coherent-pairing (no matching Python runtime). It is revisited only if upstream publishes a matching Python runtime artifact.
